page.layout: One text column at the top of the page; below it a woodcut ornament, with a library stamp over the lower left (not transcribed). Page number at the lower left of the foot.

main_text.p: eo uti consensisse. Qua item ratione Constantinopolitanum ursit,& insecutus est, eadem non minus contra Romanum Episcopum valet: Quid tu Christo universalis Ecclesiæ capiti in extremi judicij dicturus es Examine, qui cuncta ejus membra tibimet conaris universalis appellatione supponere? lib.IV.Ep.38. Hæc vera est universalis Episcopi definitio: hoc modo Ecclesi-am DEI, cunctaque ejus membra Gregorium Sedi suæ subje-cisse, probari nequit.
IX. An detur Ecclesia Prædestinatorum, &,an Ecclesiæ Reformatæ doctrina de Prædestinatione, Gratia & Liberoar-bitrio sit vera & orthodoxa?

page.notes: Woodcut ornament below the text, not transcribed. Library stamp (Stadtbibliothek Zürich) over the lower left, not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible throughout and was left out. The page number is very faint and uncertain. "DEI" and "FINIS, BONO CUM DEO." are set in small capitals, rendered here in capitals.
